activecampaign.name: ActiveCampaign
activecampaign.free: No permanent free plan · 14-day trial · up to 100 contacts / 100 emails in trial
activecampaign.paid: Starts at $15/month for accounts under 1,000 contacts
activecampaign.strength: Advanced marketing automation, segmentation and CRM-style lifecycle workflows.
activecampaign.watch: No permanent free plan; pricing scales with contact volume and feature needs.
activecampaign.affiliate: Official affiliate program: 30% recurring commission for eligible referrals, paid for up to 12 months. ToolPilot has no active affiliate link yet.

getresponse.name: GetResponse
getresponse.free: Free forever · up to 500 contacts · up to 2,500 messages/month
getresponse.strength: Email marketing plus landing pages, funnels and lifecycle automation in one stack.
getresponse.watch: Free loses premium features after the initial trial; advanced automation requires paid tiers.
getresponse.affiliate: Official recurring affiliate program starts at 33%; a separate bounty program pays $100 per qualifying sale. ToolPilot has no active affiliate link yet.

brevo.name: Brevo
brevo.free: Free · 300 email sends/day · up to 100,000 stored contacts
brevo.strength: Low-cost multichannel email, transactional messaging and automation with a generous free entry point.
brevo.watch: Daily send limits and tier-specific automation/features matter more than raw contact storage.
brevo.affiliate: Brevo has a PartnerStack affiliate program, but approval requires an established relevant website and professional email. ToolPilot has no active affiliate link yet.

mailerlite.name: MailerLite
mailerlite.free: Free · up to 250 active subscribers · 2,500 emails every 30 days
mailerlite.paid: Paid plans start around the low-teens monthly and scale by subscriber tier
mailerlite.strength: Simple general email marketing with forms, landing pages, sites and automation at a low starting cost.
mailerlite.watch: The 2026 free plan is intentionally small; subscriber and email limits arrive quickly.
mailerlite.affiliate: ToolPilot has no active MailerLite affiliate link yet.
